change.title: refactor(renderer): remove never-imported ui primitives (-2,763 LOC)
change.description:
## Summary

Deletes 25 `src/renderer/components/ui/` files (2,763 lines) that have zero importers — unused shadcn primitives (sidebar, chart, carousel, menubar, form, navigation-menu, and 19 more) installed but never wired in. Part of a codebase-wide LOC slimdown: a fresh tokei scan showed +9.2% code growth this cycle with zero files deleted, and ~5,800 LOC of verified-dead code accumulated.

## Related Issue

No related issue — codebase health initiative from a local LOC-slimdown recon (`_bmad-output/planning-artifacts/research/technical-codebase-loc-slimdown-2026-10-02/research.md`).

## Type of Change

- [ ] feat: new feature
- [ ] fix: bug fix
- [ ] docs: documentation only
- [ ] style: formatting or non-functional styling changes
- [ ] perf: performance improvement
- [ ] test: adds or updates tests
- [ ] build: build or dependency changes
- [ ] ci: CI/CD workflow changes
- [ ] chore: maintenance or tooling
- [ ] revert: reverts a previous change

## What Changed

- Deleted 25 never-imported `components/ui/*.tsx` primitives and their dead `ui/` helpers (`use-toast.ts` re-export, `stores/index.ts` zero-importer barrel).
- Verified via import-graph + per-file symbol grep: relative imports, barrels, vite aliases, and dynamic references all checked. One candidate (`accordion.tsx`) was a false positive — imported relatively by `PlanPanel.tsx` — and was restored before commit.

## How It Was Tested

- [ ] `bun run ci` (Biome lint + format + imports, strict mode)
- [ ] `bun run test`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` (in src-tauri)
- [ ] `cargo test` (in src-tauri)
- [ ] Not applicable

## Screenshots or Recordings

N/A — dead code deletion, no UI change.

## CI & Review Gate

- [ ] All CI checks pass (PR Validation, Rust Checks, Build Verification, Security Scans)
- [ ] Code review comments from CodeRabbit / Claude have been addressed or resolved
- [ ] No unresolved review findings remain

## Checklist

- [ ] A human reviewed the complete diff before submission

## Notes for reviewers

Overlaps with open i18n PR #648, which localizes `ui/sidebar.tsx` and `ui/carousel.tsx` — whichever merges second needs a trivial delete-vs-modify rebase on dead files.

refactor(renderer): remove never-imported ui primitives

25 shadcn-style primitives in components/ui/ have zero importers
(verified via import graph + symbol grep): sidebar, chart, carousel,
menubar, form, navigation-menu, breadcrumb, drawer, pagination, table,
input-otp, calendar, card, toggle-group, tabs, alert, avatar,
radio-group, BrailleSpinner (+test), checkbox, slider, progress,
aspect-ratio, and the ui/use-toast re-export shim.

~2,200 code lines removed. No behavior change.
